instruction: The members of click's internal Sentinel enum (click._utils.Sentinel, for example UNSET) are meant to be singletons compared by identity, but copy.copy(), copy.deepcopy() and a pickle round-trip either fail or produce a different object. Make all three return the very same member for every Sentinel member, so structures that contain sentinels can be copied and pickled safely. Add tests.
instruction_source: written from the fix commit message, linked issue and hidden tests; describes behavior, not the change
